AHS 13 Part 3: Is Ashley Playing Ben? 👀 American Horror Story 13 Ep 9 & 10

short // Oct 17, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Ashley, are you dating Ben or gathering evidence? Because that relationship is starting to look like a wiretap with benefits. 👀

This is Part 3 of my American Horror Story 13 breakdown, covering episodes 9 and 10, "The Devil Is in the Details" and "The Prodigal Son."

⚠️ Spoilers for American Horror Story 13 through episode 10.

My double cross: still on the board

Last time, in Part 2, I said I smelled a double cross. Did my pick turn on everybody yet? Not yet. But somebody's definitely working an angle.

Ashley is giving Constance the recap

Ashley is giving Ben romance, and giving Constance the recap. Girl, where's your professional camera?

Every date looks like a debrief. If Ashley's reporting back, the question is what Constance does with what she learns.

Give Mallory the championship first

Mallory, yes, you kept the secret. The witches have questions. Fair.

But this girl went back in time and ran over the Antichrist to save everybody. Back in Apocalypse, Mallory reset the whole timeline and hit Michael Langdon with her car before he could end the world. That's the Terminator: Coven Edition. She hit him with a four-wheel finisher.

Ask your questions. Give her the championship first.

Ben at the witches' door

Then Ben shows up at the witches' door. Sir, you just had a conversation with your daddy, and now you're over here?

Are you asking for help, or are you bringing everybody a problem? I'm not calling Ben a traitor yet. But everybody in this season wants something.

Who's a move ahead?

My question is who's already a move ahead. Who gets what they want, and who gets what they deserve? Those are two very different reservations.

My double-cross prediction is still on the board. (That's my XFD theory, not confirmed.)

Sources: Fiction Horizon: AHS 13 episode 9 release date and preview, TVLine: AHS 13 episodes 7 and 8 explained, Wikipedia: American Horror Story: Apocalypse, Wikipedia: American Horror Story season 13

Quick answers

What are AHS 13 episodes 9 and 10 called? Episode 9 is "The Devil Is in the Details" and episode 10 is "The Prodigal Son." Both aired October 15, 2026.

How did Mallory stop the Antichrist in American Horror Story? In the Apocalypse finale, Mallory traveled back in time and ran over Michael Langdon with her car, resetting the timeline before he could end the world.

When is the American Horror Story 13 finale? Episodes 11 and 12 are listed for October 22, and the finale for October 29, 2026.

Who do you trust going into episodes 11 and 12? Tell me in the comments. 👇
